title: festuca indigesta subsp. litardierei
intro: Festuca indigesta subsp. litardierei, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a type of grass species within the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Festuca indigesta subsp. litardierei are thought to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
